There is a quiet emergency in America making us sicker and poorer.

Sicker because the food we are feeding our families is driving a chronic disease epidemic.

Poorer because a handful of mega-corporations are driving up the costs of groceries, insurance, and prescription drugs for diseases they shouldn’t have gotten in the first place.

The Supreme Court ruling did not just eviscerate the Voting Rights Act, it was a desecration of the martyrs who struggled and fought for fairness and representation.

We must not stand for it. We must rise with a chorus of conviction and demand a government that truly represents every single one of us.

Donald Trump promised American families he’d cut gas and electricity prices in half. 

Now, thanks to his chaos and corruption, Americans are being crushed by high prices at the pump and slammed with rising energy bills. 

We need to act now to ease the pain on working families.

op:@decodingfoxnews

Video

Trump lied, now prices are up and we’re in a war costing us billions. We need more people lifting their voice to demand accountability for this failed presidency.

op: @nowthisimpact

Video

Over 100 years ago today, the Supreme Court struck a blow against Black Americans in Plessy v. Ferguson. Just days ago, the court struck another blow against us.

It took a movement moment to end “separate but equal” with Brown v. Board. We must meet this moment with a movement of our own — one that mobilizes, organizes, and fights relentlessly for what is right.

It is an unassailable fact that Trump is selling out America for his own personal profit. This stock trading, which should be illegal for all presidents and politicians, is gross corruption and should be offensive to every American.

op: @lawyeroyer

Video

Don't let your inability to do everything undermine your determination to do something.

Video

Now is not the time to agonize. It is time to organize.

Not time to retreat, but to rise. 

To activate. To engage. To mobilize.

Democracy is not a spectator sport. 

This moment demands our presence, our courage, and our action.

We have work to do. Let’s show up and meet the demands of this moment.

Video

Donald Trump is clear: American families’ financial struggles don’t matter to him at all.

If congressional Republicans don’t want to hold him accountable and help end his reckless wars and bring down prices, they should get the hell out of the way.

Video

This makes me ticked off. The Trump administration gutted USAID over a year ago, but the devastating human cost has continued. We cannot look away. We must restore our leadership and fight for aid programs to feed children, improve global health, and protect our national interests.

Video

Trump’s settlement is so effing ridiculous. 

Republicans in Congress are enabling historic levels of corruption, graft, and greed as Trump steals hundreds of millions of dollars from our nation.

Video

We can feel the despair and sorrow about this roll back of our rights that people bled and fought for, but we must also hold in our heart a defiant joy.

Video

This is the most corrupt President in the history of our country.

But let me be clear: every branch of our government now has corruption that is cancerous and eating away at our democracy. 

We must demand change.
